name: @deepsea/fs-tools
description: DeepSea plugin: batch filesystem tools beside the built-ins: list_dir (directories included), read_many (several line ranges per call, observed for the read-before-edit guard), edit_many (several edits across files, validated before any write, with an optional verify command) and search (literal/word/regex selectors and exclusions, context, files/count modes, path globs and several roots).
